notes:
Passed on the fake backend (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware is attached and no hardware run was made. Only the first card entry symbol is implemented: manipulator_learning.sim.envs.panda_play:PandaPlayInsertTrayXYZState. The other four symbols (ThingDoorMultiview, ThingInsertMultiview, ThingPickAndInsertSucDoneMultiview and ThingLiftXYZStateMultiview) are named with file:line in facts.md and are not implemented (one device per package). The fake backend is the package's own pure Python analytic stand-in (fake.py) and was never compared with the upstream PyBullet environment; pybullet, numpy, gym, transforms3d and liegroups were not importable/run where the gate ran. NOT COVERED: PyBullet rigid-body dynamics, joints, IK, contacts, friction, actuators, sensors, cameras and rendering; only the pos, vel, grip_pos and prev_grip_pos slots of the 59-value observation are modelled (the object, relative-position and force-torque slots are zeros); the fake reward is the placeholder 0.0 and is not the upstream insert reward; the episode limit is the upstream 360-step time limit reported as the legacy terminated flag. env_id is the class name, not a gym.make registration (README.md:172), so the sim backend (gym.make) cannot open this class and was not run. The fake draws start jitter with Python's random.Random while upstream PBEnv.seed uses numpy's seeding.np_random, so one seed does not give the same trajectory on the two. Warnings are the expected bridge-derived ones: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed class only sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived numeric inputs (ticks, seed in reset, seed in seed, action.values); there were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. The risk is R1 because the capability advances a simulated robot arm (MHS-004 section 2.1 lists simulation stepping as R1); the card's floor is R0 and there is no hardware backend or physical e-stop claim. Only catalogue classes cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
